messages:
emma_support: Customer (acme-app) started seeing intermittent SSO failures after their IdP rolled certs ~2h ago. ~30% of users hit an error during redirect and say they get logged out instead of to app. Error in our logs:

emma_support: `SAMLResponse verification failed: Signature validation error` and occasionally `RecipientMismatch` when RelayState contains query params like `?next=/dashboard`.

matt_prodops: Do we have the raw SAMLResponse/relay? Can you paste sanitized logs and exact ACS we reported to IdP?

emma_support: Pasting minimal repro logs (sanitized):
```
[2024-10-12T14:02:33Z] POST /saml/acs 400 RecipientMismatch relayState="/app?next=/dashboard"
[2024-10-12T14:02:34Z] POST /saml/acs 401 SignatureValidationError issuer="https://idp.example.com" cert-fingerprint=OLD_FP
```

leah_engineer: Quick read: two things jump out. 1) Our ACS URL is canonicalized with a trailing slash (`/saml/acs/`) in SP metadata but the customer's IdP is sometimes posting to `/saml/acs` (no slash) when RelayState has querystring — some intermediate CDN/proxy is stripping or rewriting. That causes recipient mismatch when IdP uses ACS index vs exact URL. 2) The logs show verification against OLD_FP -> looks like IdP published both new+old certs but an upstream metadata cache (their CDN or ours) served stale metadata intermittently, causing signature failures.

matt_prodops: Repro steps we ran: 1) Rotate certs on IdP (they published metadata with both certs). 2) Their metadata propagated to Idp CDN but with mixed TTLs -> some edge nodes returned old cert only. 3) Login flows with RelayState containing query params triggered POSTs to the non‑trailing slash ACS (rewritten by their load balancer). Result: some assertions signed with new cert verified ok; others hit old-cert-only nodes -> signature fail; and ACS exact URL mismatch -> RecipientMismatch.

emma_support: Customer says failures started immediately after cert rotation and were intermittent. They also reported a 504 from our proxy for a handful of attempts.

leah_engineer: Proposed mitigation steps we applied for the customer (short term):
- Temporarily accept both ACS variants: add `/saml/acs` as an alternate ACS in SP config and treat trailing-slash as equivalent for recipient matching.
- Relax cert check to allow signature verification against both cert fingerprints for 24h while they finish rotation (logging an alert when old cert used).
- Invalidate/ask their CDN to purge IdP metadata edge caches (and set TTL low).
- Add a small retry on 504s for SSO POSTs to tolerate transient proxy errors.

matt_prodops: Done: added alternate ACS mapping and enabled dual-cert verification for the tenant. Purged our cached IdP metadata for their tenant.

emma_support: I sent their SAML expert a checklist: confirm metadata contains both certs during overlap, ensure CDN TTLs set to <5m for metadata during rotation, and avoid modifying ACS path rewrite rules. They confirmed they'll purge their CDN as well.

leah_engineer: Long-term runbook items:
- Update our SP metadata to include both ACS variants during rotations automatically.
- Add an automated check that flags if IdP metadata served from their CDN lacks the expected certs.
- Document accept-window for old certs + auditing.

sso-infra: Created internal ticket INFRA-489 to add metadata edge cache verifier and ACS normalization test.

idp-bot: Deploy complete: idp-metadata-acceptor v1.2.3 -> live in staging.

emma_support: Customer confirmed after we purged caches + added ACS mapping their logins look stable. Monitoring for 48h. They appreciate the quick fix. :thumbsup:

matt_prodops: Filed escalation ticket SUP-12345 and assigned postmortem to @leah_engineer.

leah_engineer: Will write a short postmortem + runbook update tomorrow. Also adding unit tests for ACS URL normalization and cert-overlap handling.

emma_support: Closing thread for now — will reopen if failures exceed 1% over next 48h.
